In this design, cold is produced by two methods:

* **Free cooling**: The cooling towers cool the network directly on colder days, covering 88.6% of the annual demand (about 21 GWh).

| Method | Share of demand | Capacity (peak) |
|---|---|---|
| Free cooling towers | 88.6% | up to 8.6 MW |
| Electric chillers | 11.4% | 2.94 MW on peak day |

The chillers draw 0.3 GWh/yr from the grid and reject heat to the cooling towers.
